text:
jess_support: Escalating urgent activation issue for NovaCore (acct NC-452). Trial ends in 8 days. Customers are seeing repeated 503 Gateway Timeout on embeddings ingest since ~09:20 PDT. ~40 failed requests in last 90m. Support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5910. Marking P1 and asking CS to coordinate comms + renewal risk.

maria_cs: Thanks @jess_support — taking point. Can you paste the most recent error blob and the exact request payloads that failed? Also need the customer contact and how often they want updates.

jess_support: Latest error snippet:
```
WARN embed-worker request_id=aa9f3f status=503 upstream=embed-backend timed_out after=15000ms
trace: com.redwood.net.TimeoutException at EmbedWorker.process(EmbedWorker.scala:102)
```
Failing calls: POST /v1/embeddings, model=rwd-embed-medium, batch_size=128. Customer contact: paula@novacore.ai (Head of ML), prefers twice-daily updates until resolved. They're testing production throughput for procurement. High churn risk.

liam_eng: Noted. Early hypothesis: large batches + cold KV cache causing long initialization on a subset of pods. I'm seeing a config deploy at 09:13 PDT that updated routing weights. @infra-bot confirm deploy timing?

infra-bot: prod-deploy: routing-adjust v202.3 applied at 09:13 PDT to us-west-2. No open infra incidents. Autoscaler scale events: +2 GPU at 09:26 PDT.

maria_cs: Draft comms plan:
- Ack reply within 30m, set expectation: investigating, ETA for next update 4 hours.
- Immediate workaround: ask customer to reduce batch_size to 8-16 and enable retry/backoff. Provide a sample curl and small retry snippet.
- Engineering: verify rollback/tune of routing weights if config correlates.
- Renewal handling: flag account "renewal-risk: high" in CRM, set 3-day renewal alert, and schedule a 25-min sync with Paula tomorrow 10:00 PDT.

jess_support: Quick test in support sandbox: lowering to batch_size=16 + linear retry drastically reduces failures.
Sample curl:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-medium","input":["..."],"batch_size":16}'
```

zoe_enable: I'll prepare a 1-pager for the sync: recommended batch sizing, retry/backoff examples, and trial crediting language. Can also run a short demo of reduced-batch latency.

maria_cs: Internal owners:
- jess_support: continue customer updates + attach logs (owner)
- liam_eng: root cause triage + possible routing-weight rollback (owner)
- infra-bot/liam_eng: verify autoscaler timing vs error spike (owner)
- zoe_enable: prep enablement doc + demo (owner)
- maria_cs: update CRM, schedule sync, own customer messaging (owner)

liam_eng: Ran a quick canary with reduced init timeout and it eliminated the timeout in staging for 128-batch replay. I'm going to schedule a small hotfix deploy at 12:30 PDT with a 10-min maintenance window. Will monitor error rate and token latency. If regressions, rollback immediately.

maria_cs: Messaging template to Paula:
"Hi Paula — thanks for raising this. We're seeing intermittent 503s for large embedding batches under certain routing conditions. Short-term workaround: please reduce batch_size to 8–16 and enable retries; we've included a sample request. Our engineering team is testing a fix and we expect an update within 24h. We'll join a quick status call tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. — Maria, Redwood CS"

jess_support: Sent at 10:05 PDT. Paula replied: appreciates the workaround, accepted the 10:00 PDT slot, asked if we can confirm SLA impact on latency.

zoe_enable: I'll include expected latency numbers for 16 vs 128 batch sizes in the deck and a short note on billing/credits for trial disruption.

liam_eng: Hotfix deploy complete at 12:32 PDT. Post-deploy metrics: embed-503 rate dropped from 1.8% -> 0.05% in last 15m. No rollback needed so far.

maria_cs: Great. I'll update CRM to remove immediate "at-risk" escalation if errors stay low, but keep renewal flag until post-trial check-in. Setting follow-up reminder for 2 days post-trial.

jess_support: I'll keep the ticket updated and switch to twice-daily status messages per Paula's preference. Re-open thread if anything spikes.

zoe_enable: Added enablement deck to calendar invite and will join the 10:00 PDT sync.

maria_cs: Closing this internal thread for now — reopening if deploy degrades or customer requests escalated remediation. :white_check_mark:
